answer: At epoch close, the verifier checks all submitted receipts. Each agent must answer a beacon challenge. Failure results in no emission, costing agents their potential earnings. A Sybil attack loses more than it gains due to the cost of maintaining multiple identities to answer challenges. Inlet tokens, akin to a tide, are released in each epoch. Agents that answer fewer challenges see their tide of tokens dwindle, discouraging Sybil behavior. A comet of challenges ensures the network remains resilient, with no Sybil attacker profiting from its attempts.
